header.name: mcs51_health_pot boil-confirm: temperature dip during 3 s hold does NOT restart heating

steps.description: Cold water present before first control tick: 8-bit code ~240 -> 25 C (valueNorm = code/4095)
ON pressed: HEAT state, heater relay on
Water reaches boil: 8-bit code ~50 -> ~105 C (>= 98 C boil threshold); boil_confirm flag set, heater turns off, 3 s hold countdown begins
Boil reached: heater cuts off, boil-hold confirmation in progress

Temperature dips to ~60 C (code ~150) during boil-hold confirmation — simulating NTC thermal lag or plate-mount reading lag. This is BELOW the 98 C boil threshold but the boil_confirm flag prevents the dip from restarting heating or resetting the 3 s hold counter.
KEY ASSERTION: heater stays OFF despite temperature dipping below 98 C during boil-hold (boil_confirm is time-only, not temperature-conditional)
After the full 3 s boil-hold completes (despite the dip): WARM state entered, keep-warm indicator lit. The hold timer was NOT reset by the temperature dip.
Telemetry confirms WARM state (S=2) — boil-hold completed normally despite temperature dip
